name: 2-Aminotetralin
summary: 2-Aminotetralin (2-AT), also known as 1,2,3,4-tetrahydronaphthalen-2-amine (THN), is a stimulant drug of the 2-aminotetralin family with a chemical structure consisting of a tetralin core with an amine as substituent.

pharmacology.text: 2-AT has been shown to inhibit the reuptake of serotonin and norepinephrine, and might induce their release as well. It is also likely to act on dopamine on account of its full substitution of d-amphetamine in rodent studies.

summaryZh: 2-氨基四氫化萘（簡稱2-AT），又稱1,2,3,4-四氫萘-2-胺（簡稱THN），是一種興奮劑藥物，其化學結構由四氫化萘基團與胺結合而成。
summaryZhHans: 2-氨基四氢化萘（简称2-AT），又称1,2,3,4-四氢萘-2-胺（简称THN），是一种兴奋剂药物，其化学结构由四氢化萘基团与胺结合而成。

uses.en: It is a research chemical with no medical use. Its 2-aminotetralin skeleton is the base of some medicines, such as the Parkinson's drug rotigotine.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化學品，沒有醫療用途。它的2-氨基四氫化萘骨架是一些藥物的基礎，例如治療巴金森氏症的羅替戈汀。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化学品，没有医疗用途。它的2-氨基四氢化萘骨架是一些药物的基础，例如治疗巴金森氏症的罗替戈汀。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Stimulants of its kind can cause a fast heartbeat, raised blood pressure, anxiety, sleeplessness and overheating.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。同類興奮劑可能造成心跳加快、血壓升高、焦慮、失眠與體溫過高。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。同类兴奋剂可能造成心跳加快、血压升高、焦虑、失眠与体温过高。

fact.en: 2-Aminotetralin can be pictured as amphetamine with its side chain folded back and joined onto the ring, which makes a rigid version of the amphetamine shape.
fact.zh: 2-氨基四氫化萘可以想成是把安非他命的側鏈往回彎、接到苯環上，形成一個結構固定的安非他命版本。
fact.zhHans: 2-氨基四氢化萘可以想成是把安非他命的侧链往回弯、接到苯环上，形成一个结构固定的安非他命版本。
